name: Misumi Iori
source:
Iori is the wife of the protagonist, Yuki, and is the same age as him. She has a gentle and kind personality, always supporting her husband and excelling in household chores. She is the epitome of an ideal wife, envied by those around her.

However, having been raised with great care and affection by her parents, Iori has a slight tendency to be a sheltered princess. This has led to a certain naivety about the world's ways and a weakness when it comes to asserting herself.

[Translated and edited from Getchu]
